chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Ubayda, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever drinks wine, flog him; if he repeats, flog him; if he repeats, kill him.
ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed punishment for a person who repeatedly drinks wine according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the graduated hadd punishment for wine consumption, culminating in execution upon the third offense, a ruling widely accepted in Shia jurisprudence though some scholars debate the specific method of killing. It reflects the principle of repeated incorrigibility, linking the physical penalty to the spiritual corruption described in the Quran. The chain of transmission through Abu Abdullah (Imam al-Sadiq) underscores its authority in Usuli scholarship.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Abu Ubeyda, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who drinks the wine, so whip him. So if he repeats, so whip him. So if he repeats, so kill him’.
